map.credit: Plan page: "© Aristéas 2016" (aerial view illustration); photo credits "© Musée du Louvre / Olivier Ouadah", "© 2015 Musée du Louvre / Michel Denancé", "© RMN - Grand Palais (Musée du Louvre) / …" etc. Suggested attribution: "Plan: musée du Louvre, édition mai 2026 (Dream On / Service de la médiation graphique et numérique)".
map.pdf_structure: 2 pages, each 864.6 x 2126 pt. Page 1 = aerial view, intro, practical info, wing/level collection list. Page 2 = five stacked level plans (2, 1, 0, -1, -2) with room numbers, lifts/stairs letters, toilets, cafés, cloakroom; legend of museum rules at the bottom (cropped away).
map.room_numbers_note: Yes. The official plan prints room numbers for every room plus highlight works with their room: La Joconde 711, Victoire de Samothrace 703, Galerie d'Apollon 705, Vénus de Milo 345, Scribe accroupi 635, Esclave mourant 403, Palais de Darius 308, Ebih-Il 234, Appartements Napoléon III 544, La Liberté guidant le peuple 700, La Dentellière 837, Le Tricheur 912, etc. Hatched yellow = rooms closed for renovation (as of May 2026 print). For per-object location use collections.louvre.fr, field 'Localisation', e.g. Mona Lisa: "Denon, [Peint] Salle 711 - Salle de la Joconde, Salle 711 - (Salle des Etats)" + "Aile Denon, Niveau 1" (https://collections.louvre.fr/ark:/53355/cl010062370, fetched 2026-11-21; page warns locations may be out of date during a system overhaul).

hours.regular: Mon, Thu, Sat, Sun 09:00-18:00; Wed & Fri 09:00-21:00 (late opening).
hours.room_clearing: Rooms start clearing 30 min before closing (17:30; 20:30 Wed/Fri).
hours.level2_late_open: Wed & Fri: level-2 rooms (Richelieu 800s, Sully 900s) open only at 10:30.
hours.timed_entry: Time-slot booking RECOMMENDED for everyone (incl. free-entry visitors); on-site sales only when attendance is low. MANDATORY reservation for all visitors 19 Dec 2026 - 4 Jan 2027 (exemptions: Amis du Louvre, CLEF+, patrons, disabled visitors + companion, etc.).
hours.official_ticketing: https://ticket.louvre.fr/en (beware mirror/resale sites; museum may refuse entry)
date_specific_notices: Sun 22 Nov 2026: "The museum may open later and some exhibition rooms may remain closed." (no reason given)

entrances.name: Pyramide

entrances.name: Carrousel (99 rue de Rivoli, via Galerie du Carrousel)
entrances.status: listed for all visitors (groups, members, ticket holders); current live status not stated in text
entrances.notes: Connects to the underground car park, 1 av. du Général Lemonnier. Confirm on day.

entrances.name: Porte des Lions (Quai François-Mitterrand)
entrances.status: open except Tuesdays, ticket holders only
entrances.notes: Closes 18:00, last entry 17:00; its lockers close 15:00; no equipment loans. Usually the shortest queue. Opens directly into Denon (Spanish painting / Arts de l'Islam end).

entrances.name: Passage Richelieu (rue de Rivoli)
entrances.notes: Groups, members, auditorium/activity attendees, institutional cards only. Closes after 17:30 (19:30 Wed/Fri). Not for regular individual ticket holders.

hours.transport: Metro Palais-Royal / Musée du Louvre (lines 1, 7) - direct underground access via Carrousel; Pyramides (line 14). Buses 21, 27, 39, 67, 68, 69, 72, 74, 85, 95. Batobus stop Louvre.
hours.security: Vigipirate 'Vigilance renforcée'; bags opened at security.

tickets.non_eea: EUR 32 (applies to Israeli visitors) - non-EEA rate since 14 Jan 2026
tickets.groups_non_eea: EUR 28 per person (guided groups, max 20) - press reports
tickets.free: Under 18 (ID); EEA citizens/residents under 26; everyone on first Friday of the month after 18:00 (not Jul/Aug) - i.e. Fri 4 Dec 2026 evening; 14 July; disabled visitor + companion; some professional categories. Free visitors still advised to book a slot.
tickets.delacroix_museum: Same-day Louvre ticket gives free entry to Musée Eugène-Delacroix (6 rue de Furstemberg), same day or next opening day

practical.cloakroom_lockers: Free self-service lockers under the Pyramid (Hall Napoléon, level -2, 'Vestiaire') and at Porte des Lions (closes 15:00). Max item size 55x35x20 cm; suitcases/large bags refused. Same-day pickup. Source: https://www.louvre.fr/en/visit/visitor-amenities
practical.audioguide: Official audioguide EUR 6, 150+ works / 200+ commentaries, 9 languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, IT, PT, ZH, KO, JA - no Hebrew). Rent at ticket office level -2 or reserve online; collect at Sully and Denon counters level -1. Max 6 per person. Nintendo 3DS guide was retired 1 Sep 2025; device type of the replacement not stated on louvre.fr. Sources: plan PDF May 2026; https://www.louvre.fr/en/visit/visitor-amenities; https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/the-louvre-stops-renting-out-nintendo-3ds-consoles-which-helped-visitors-navigate-the-massive-museum-for-13-years-180987328/
practical.apps: No official Louvre visit app (Louvre FAQ: https://contact.louvre.fr/hc/fr/articles/20178024833053-Proposez-vous-une-application-de-visite). Use the interactive map https://collections.louvre.fr/plan and the collections database. Exhibition-only web app for Zurbarán (zurbaran.louvre.fr).
practical.wifi: Free 'Louvre_Wifi_Gratuit' under the Pyramid and in galleries, 1-hour renewable sessions.
practical.photos: Photos/video for personal use allowed in permanent collections; NO flash, selfie sticks or lighting; some temporary-exhibition works not photographable. Tripods not addressed. Source: https://www.louvre.fr/en/visit/museum-rules ; 2026 rules PDF https://api-www.louvre.fr/sites/default/files/2026-01/2026_Reglement_de_visite_Musee_du_Louvre.pdf
practical.food: No eating/drinking in galleries. Cafés inside the palace include Café Mollien (Denon 1, by the Mollien staircase/room 700, terrace over Pyramid), Café Richelieu-Angelina (Richelieu 1, near Napoleon III apts), Terrasse Colbert, La Boulangerie du Louvre, Café Pyramide & Les Comptoirs du Louvre (Hall Napoléon area), MUSES, Café des Lions. Plan PDF: terraces Mollien, Richelieu, Colbert overlook the Pyramid. Sources: https://www.louvre.fr/en/visit/restaurants-cafes ; plan PDF.
practical.toilets: In Hall Napoléon and throughout the wings; marked on each level PNG (e.g. Denon 1 near 715 and 720, Richelieu 1 near 564/519/500, Sully 1 near 645/636). Most with baby changing. Free toilets also in Tuileries.
practical.accessibility: Free loan of wheelchairs, strollers, baby carriers, canes, folding stools at Espace Assistance, level -2 (ID deposit).
practical.current_exhibitions: Louvre Photo (4 Nov 2026 - 3 May 2027); Zurbarán (7 Oct 2026 - 25 Jan 2027); Sculpting Colour (Valladolid) - per search summaries, unverified on louvre.fr
